interpretations: Count every `player_college` row per `college_id`, including rows with a null `player_id`; treat null `college_id` as one group. Use those counts to calculate all three requested averages.

Count rows with a non-null `player_id` per `college_id`, allowing the same player to count more than once when they have multiple records. Treat null `college_id` as one group, then calculate all three averages.

Count distinct non-null `player_id` values per `college_id`, so each player counts once at each college regardless of how many years they appear. Treat null `college_id` as one group, then calculate all three averages.
Count distinct `player_id` values per `college_id`, treating null `player_id` as one distinct value within a group. Treat null `college_id` as one group, then calculate all three averages.

Include colleges listed in `college` with no matching `player_college` records as zero-player colleges when calculating the all-college average and total; also include the null `college_id` group from `player_college`. Calculate the three requested averages for groups above that baseline.
queries:
WITH college_counts AS (
    SELECT
        college_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) + MAX(player_id IS NULL) AS player_count
    FROM player_college
    GROUP BY college_id
)
SELECT
    AVG(player_count) AS arithmetic_mean,
    EXP(AVG(LN(player_count))) AS geometric_mean,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(1.0 / player_count) AS harmonic_mean
FROM college_counts
